## Role in the Rating Process

The Council of the EU is a key decision-maker in the fiscal surveillance framework. It formally opens and closes excessive deficit procedures and decides on effective action. These decisions serve as bright-line inputs for assessing [Backstop Eligibility](../parameters/backstop-eligibility.qmd) (R6). The Council also endorses national fiscal plans under the EU fiscal framework, which relates to the assessment of [Fiscal Capacity](../parameters/fiscal-capacity.qmd) and history-lags-policy risks (C3-T*).

## Evidence by Country

- The Council of the EU made financial assistance available under the Security Action for Europe (SAFE) instrument for defence spending in multiple member states. <button type="button" class="source-ref" data-source="ec/country-reports/Bulgaria_2026-06-03, p. 6" aria-label="Source: ec/country-reports/Bulgaria_2026-06-03, p. 6">ⓘ</button>

### [Netherlands](../countries/netherlands.qmd)
